name: Network
description: Connection state in the bar and a network panel: connection details with ping and traffic, speed test, Wi-Fi switch, Wi-Fi band, DNS provider and the Wi-Fi networks in range (Quickshell.Networking)

showName.description: Show the connected network name next to the glyph

maxNetworks.description: Wi-Fi networks listed in the panel (connected, then saved, then strongest)

debugIpc.description: Test hook: expose IPC target haseen.network (state, prompt) while the panel is open; it never connects, forgets, changes band or DNS, or toggles radios
